summary: San Kamphaeng’s Chiang Mai–San Kamphaeng Road has several operating ceramics makers and showrooms. Baan Celadon explicitly invites visitors to tour its factory floor and browse its showroom; Siam Celadon and Prempracha are nearby alternatives for celadon and handmade stoneware shopping. Treat these as working-factory visits and retail browsing, not as pottery classes.
whyGo: See a working ceramics factory and browse traditional celadon tableware, decorative pieces and gifts in one visit at Baan Celadon.
Compare several local makers along the same craft corridor: Siam Celadon specializes in celadon; Prempracha describes itself as a ceramic studio and factory for handmade stoneware.
Buy directly from makers and, at Baan Celadon, ask about shipping or local pickup for larger or fragile purchases.
bestFor: Ceramics and craft shoppers who want to see production as well as finished work.
A half-day outing east of Chiang Mai by car or hired ride, with two or three selected stops.
Visitors interested in celadon glaze and handmade tableware.
skipIf: You specifically want a hands-on pottery class: the factory/showroom sources reviewed do not advertise a regular visitor class.
You need a compact walkable attraction, guaranteed English-language tour, published admission price or confirmed step-free access.
duration: Allow around 2–4 hours for one or two factories plus travel; this is a planning estimate, since no standard tour duration is published. Ask Baan Celadon how much time to allow for its factory-floor tour.
cost: Showroom and factory-tour admission prices are not published by Baan Celadon, and no admission fee is stated for Siam Celadon or Prempracha; confirm before travelling. Budget separately for purchases, transport and any shipping. No current ceramics-class price was verified for this route.
hours: Baan Celadon lists its showroom daily 09:00–17:00 and factory floor Tuesday–Saturday 09:00–17:00, closed Sundays and national holidays. The Tourism Authority of Thailand lists Siam Celadon daily 08:15–17:00. Prempracha lists 08:30–17:30 Monday–Saturday. Recheck holiday hours for December.
bestTime: Go on a weekday morning, when factory-floor access is listed at Baan Celadon and production activity may be visible; ask before photographing workers or entering work areas. A showroom-only visit is possible at Baan Celadon on Sunday, but its factory floor is closed.
gettingThere: The studios are spread along Chiang Mai–San Kamphaeng Road, east of the city. The Tourism Authority of Thailand estimates about 20 minutes by car to Siam Celadon and says a San Kamphaeng songthaew takes about 30 minutes; confirm the route, drop-off and return service locally. A car or app-based ride is more practical for linking multiple stops. Baan Celadon is at 7 Moo 3, Sanklang; Siam Celadon at 38 Moo 10, Ton Pao; Prempracha at 224 Moo 3, Ton Pao.
booking: Baan Celadon invites visitors to tour the factory floor but publishes no reservation process or tour capacity. Contact it in advance at +66 53 338 288 or info@baanceladon.store to confirm tour access, language and time; contact each alternative before making a special trip. The separate Charmlearn two-hour, ฿1,200 hands-on workshop listing was for Chiang Mai Design Week in December 2025, not a confirmed recurring class or December 2026 schedule.
accessibility: No reliable step-free access, accessible toilet or factory-floor route details were found for the studios. Contact the chosen venue about steps, surfaces, seating and toilet access before travelling if these affect your visit.
practicalTips: Choose stops in advance and arrange transport between them; the studios are along a road corridor, not a single pedestrian site.
Confirm tour access directly, especially for Sunday visits, national holidays and December dates.
Ask permission before taking photographs in production areas and follow staff instructions around kilns and equipment.
Check packing and international shipping options before buying large or fragile pieces; Baan Celadon publishes shipping information online.
decemberNotes: No December 2026 tour roster, class schedule or special event was found. Baan Celadon’s published factory hours exclude Sundays and national holidays, while the showroom is listed daily; verify the exact date, especially around public holidays and year-end. The December 2025 Charmlearn Design Week workshop is historical and does not establish 2026 availability.
uncertainties: Factory-tour admission, duration, language, reservation requirements and December 2026 availability are not stated online.
Accessibility details and current class offerings at the named venues are unconfirmed.
The photo reference is an official TAT page image, but a reuse license and photographer credit are not stated.
